facts.business: Vidhi Specialty Food Ingredients Limited is a leading manufacturer of superior synthetic and natural food grade colours for applications in foods & beverages, confectionaries, pharmaceuticals, feeds, cosmetics, inkjet inks and salt free colours, distributed in over 80 countries across 6 continents.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure - Property plant and equipments by geographical location (India)

key_risks: Inventory existence risk due to significance of inventory balance and complexity in determining quantities
Trade receivables risk due to significant portion of current assets and estimation of allowance for expected credit losses
facts.related_party_note: The Company is in compliance with Section 177 and 188 of the Companies Act, 2013 with respect to applicable transactions with related parties and details have been disclosed in the Standalone financial statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
